name: Super-Superfiring Turrets (BB/BBB/XX/XXX)
author: RTW3 Mod Manager
description: Up to three raised turrets forward and three aft: after B the ship designer's Add turret list offers BB and then BBB, after X it offers XX and XXX. They are copies of B and X: same arcs and raised level, saved as B and X, and the main gun list labels them BB, BBB, XX and XXX. A copy is placed one turret spacing further towards midships for each extra B or X, and weighs one more barbette step (BB x1.20 and BBB x1.30 of a plain turret, against B's x1.10; XX x1.10 and XXX x1.15, against X's x1.05). Big ships carry more centreline mounts before they count as crowded: one more for every full 15,000 t above 10,000 t, up to 12. Restart through Play with mods.
